name: cinekive
creator: Gianluca-Improta
category: Productivity scripts, workflow bridges, and integrations
description: Local cinematic stills archive with lookbooks, moodboards and semantic image search. Companion reference tool for edit and grading work. Windows and macOS installers include the engine; Linux requires Docker. Initial model downloads need internet. Free community edition and optional paid Pro features.
